req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that task titles must accept UTF-8 characters. This necessitates testing with various Unicode inputs, including typical, boundary, and invalid cases, to ensure the system handles them correctly. The tests will verify that the API correctly processes and returns task titles with Unicode characters, ensuring compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_unicode_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a task with a Unicode title.
expected: The response body contains the task with the exact Unicode title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "Tâsk Tïtle with Ünicode",
        "description": "A task with a Unicode title.",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Tâsk Tïtle with Ünicode"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a task with an empty title.
expected: The response body contains a validation error message.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "",
        "description": "A task with an empty title.",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value_error.any_str.min_length" in response.json()["detail"][0]["type"]

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_length_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a task with a title of maximum allowed length.
expected: The response body contains the task with the exact title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": max_length_title,
        "description": "A task with a max length title.",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
